facts.label: official
facts.quote: No deduction shall be allowed under Section 80G in respect of any donation of any sum exceeding two thousand rupees unless such sum is paid by any mode other than cash (section. 80G(5D)).
facts.text: Under Section 80G(5D) of the Income Tax Act, no tax deduction is permitted for any donation exceeding ₹2,000 made in cash.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: For donations under clauses (a)(iv), (a)(v), (a)(vi), (a)(via), (a)(vii), (b), and (c) – total deduction is capped at 10% of donor's adjusted gross total income.
facts.text: For donations subject to qualifying limits, the total Section 80G deduction is capped at 10% of the donor's adjusted gross total income.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: If the donations are only to "other eligible funds": one gets. 50% deduction on total donations.
facts.text: Donations made to standard approved charitable funds qualify for a 50% deduction from taxable income.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: Specific government and national funds (National. Defence Fund, PM Relief Fund, Clean Ganga. Fund, etc.) - These get 100% deduction without limit.
facts.text: Contributions to specified government and national relief funds qualify for a 100% tax deduction without any upper qualifying limit.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: a donor effectively gives ₹100 but reduces their tax outflow by ₹15 (for a 30% bracket taxpayer donating ₹100 with 50% deduction).
facts.text: A taxpayer falling in the 30% tax bracket donating ₹100 under a 50% deduction category reduces personal tax liability by ₹15.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: If you donate ₹20,000 and fall within the limits, you can usually deduct ₹10,000 from your taxable income.
facts.text: A household donating ₹20,000 to an approved charitable organisation subject to the 50% rule can deduct ₹10,000 from taxable income.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Donations to the National Defence Fund are 100% tax exempt.
facts.text: Donations made by citizens to the National Defence Fund are 100% exempt from income tax.
